description: This source file is a shell script that implements a set of tests for Git submodule fetching behavior, including recursion, configuration overrides, and edge cases. It uses shell commands, Git commands, and testing utilities to perform automated tests on Git's submodule fetch operation.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Writes expected output for fetching a submodule into a specific file.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Writes expected output for fetching a second submodule into a specific file.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Writes expected output for fetching a nested submodule in deep hierarchy.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Writes expected output for fetching a superproject commit.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in submodules and writes their expected fetch output.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in the superproject and submodules, updating expected fetch outputs.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies that actual fetch output matches expected output by concatenating expected files and comparing.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Adds files, commits, and pushes in a given repository.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares specific refs in two directories, used for verifying repository states.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs a git fetch with recursion into submodules, terminating early on specific output to prevent infinite recursion.
